title: Sweet Berry Items
description: Makes golden apples golden sweet berries and totem of undying golden sweet berries! Will also make more items sweet berries!
body:
# Bug Fixes

For Bug fixes, model fixes, and other stuff join the dicord!
[Discord](https://discord.gg/jPgH9Rgd7V)

## What is this Texture pack?

This is Texture pack focused on changing items to be berries.

**Reason: I like foxes and my skin is a fox! It goes well together.**

### Updates:

I will make further changes in the future. If you want a specific item to be changed to sweet berries so you don't have to wait. Put it in the comments or go to the discord!

### Eating Animation

For the eating Animation all you need is to download a version that has it. The versions that have the eating animations are the ones that have a capital for the V.

**V = animation v = no animation**
